judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec, test, and definition-of-done files, completely omitting the actual production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `beforeSession` is still awaited outside the `try` block, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Furthermore, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by both the issue's acceptance criteria and its own `.lore/dod.md`. On the positive side, the update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the structure of the test assertion closely match what the issue and reference implementation expected.
